categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Carries the Wallet label and modifies wallet transaction generation in src/wallet/spend.cpp and src/wallet/feebumper.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents an on-chain fingerprint where anti-fee-sniping backdating could give an RBF replacement an earlier nLockTime than the original transaction. Wallet considers transaction creation privacy and fingerprinting an explicit priority, and fixing this edge case in bumpfee resolves an identified fingerprinting leak (#26526) without disrupting normal fee bumping.
